description: An SVG background stretched to a different size is redrawn there, sharp.

florui.css: .box { width: 100px; height: 60px; background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='24' height='24'><rect width='24' height='24' fill='%23f4e9d8'/><circle cx='12' cy='12' r='8' fill='%23c1440e'/><rect x='10' y='2' width='4' height='8' fill='%231b1b2f'/></svg>"); background-size: 50px 30px; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: center; }

classification.reason: An SVG is drawn by different rasterizers (this engine's resvg and Chromium's own), so the anti-aliased edge pixels of its circle differ, by up to 35 levels in 1.2% of the pixels; the pixels inside the shapes match, and so does the geometry. Measured against desktop Chrome.
